video.title: HUGE The Witcher 3 Remastered UPDATES - Gameplay Enhancements, Steam Deck Details

protocol.status: v2 labeler B (rubric v2), independent of A
protocol.note: Drafted from the transcript alone, without seeing any jevcut output or other labels.
protocol.times_from: Lemonfox transcript; seconds in the source, so labels survive re-transcription

clips.why: Take: the Witcher 3 remaster won't make CDPR much money on paper, but they'll 'make money on the unquantifiable metric of goodwill' -- people replay it, love it, pre-order Songs of the Past, buy Witcher 4. Payoff: other publishers get this wrong because it's 'all about making money in a vacuum' and don't see the benefits of goodwill (551.0). The Shift Up / Game Science aside to 561.3 is acceptable but adds little.

Surprising fact: the Witcher 3 Wild Hunt Remaster (Sept 29) is a free upgrade for owners, so the people making out like bandits are those who bought the base game for $3.99 on sale and now get the remaster with all DLC free. Opens on 'welcome to a glaze session for Witcher 3 Wild Hunt Remaster' (the game has to be named; L002 opens on 'it'). Lands at 37.8; running on to 'GOG ran a sale and the price point was 24.99' (47.6) also works as a contrast.

also_ok.why: Same business point as the goodwill clip from the other side: 'while this update is free, don't get it twisted' -- it puts the game back in the news cycle, reaches people now in their 20s and backlog owners who paid $3.99, and 'they will be getting your money off Songs of the Past... off Witcher 4.' Works alone but overlaps the preferred clip; 'this update' leans slightly on the title.

negatives.why: Combat changes read from the announcement (animations, targeting, gap closing, dynamic camera) with a light 'camera gets jarring with many enemies' aside; sounds like an opinion segment but is mostly the list.
Feature list read aloud: finishers, signs, transmog, QoL, looting rework, photo mode, textures, path tracing, DLSS 4.5.
Quote from CDPR's executive producer read off the screen (next-gen update vs remaster, 'I'm talking about the animation...'); quotable but it's the article, and ends on 'I'll go over those in a bit'.
'CDPR are wizards when it comes to optimization' Switch 2 / Steam Deck speculation; a strong line with no payoff.
Wrap-up: 50-70 hours, DLC, 'Death March, buckle up', sign-off.
Post-roll call to hit the bell notification.
